duration.text: The Japanese at Beijing International Studies University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 7 or above 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7.Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: 1.Aged under the age of 50 2.Be in good health 3.holding undergraduate diploma or equivalent or above 4.HSK level 7 or above
